# Synth

> Synth is a social app for discovering concerts, shows, and local events, then finding others going to the same ones.

Synth combines event discovery with a social layer: users see who else is interested in or going to an event, connect with people who share their taste in music, and build a history of the shows they've attended. It integrates with Spotify and Apple Music listening history to personalize event recommendations.

## Product

- [Synth](https://join.getsynth.app/): Web app — discover concerts and local events, and find people to go with.
- [Synth on the App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/synth-for-live-music-lovers/id6757408095): iOS app.

## Concert listings

- [Concerts in Washington, DC](https://getsynth.app/concerts/washington-dc): Upcoming DC concerts by date, venue, artist and genre, updated daily.
- [Concerts in Washington, DC this weekend](https://getsynth.app/concerts/washington-dc/this-weekend): Shows from Friday through Sunday.

## Optional

- [Shared event/review previews](https://join.getsynth.app/share): Public preview pages for events, reviews, artists, and venues shared by Synth users.
